rationale.faithfulness: Round 1b: talk block structure, pooled FE and the 05-11 split all strengthen on fixed data and survive DQ8's trim; HH248 (reads mediate the room effect) and NE42 attention reallocation were predicted before running and held; active-spin claims withdrawn; holdout run on buggy data stays inconclusive. one_line: Rooms partition chat and artifacts alike; chat couples only through reads, items leak across rooms mainly via command output, and attention dilution is too small to explain re-cut jumps.
